variants.specifics: Brackenford: Garrick at the north gate, shut by Halvard because of Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Only Halvard's own men may pass this gate!

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Tobin, here is one more traveler who wants to try his luck against Red Corwin!

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Hey, you should get through before Halvard shuts the gate again.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Kettrig keeps the lift down to the Copper Deep, shut until Foreman Dagrim gives the word.

first.speaker: Kettrig
first.text: What are you doing here? The lift is shut by order! You'd best go see Foreman Dagrim if you hope to get below. The Ogres hold the Copper Deep.

again.speaker: Kettrig
again.text: Step away from that lift, lad! Unless you WANT to meet an Ogre!

later.speaker: Kettrig
later.text:
Hold it right there, stranger! Foreman Dagrim says the way below is yours and his word is good enough for me.

Step in! I've got the lift oiled and ready to go down.

Will you be going below now, stranger?

variants.specifics: Vell: Torvic of the Marsh Guard keeps the causeway gate of Vell.

first.speaker: Torvic
first.text: Lookin' to spend a night in the stocks?

later.speaker: Torvic
later.text: Fair work with the Trolls. But that doesn't make you a hero! Now move along!

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Brunwick at the east gate, barred by Baron Hadrim while Vargoth's Ogres hold the Gorge; later the gate is open.

again.speaker: Brunwick
again.text: Nobody comes in through this gate anymore.

later.speaker: Brunwick
later.text: I would see Commander Rusk at the outpost first... unless you want to fight the Ogres alone.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Tobb guards the north gate, shut by Mayor Gorvane while Black Varrick's rogues rob the north road.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: No way through! Shove off, pest!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: You'd stroll up the north road with Varrick's rogues on it!? You're daft! Now clear off! You tire me!

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Out the gate with you, lad! Enjoy the walk!

variants.specifics: Olvane: Brunt, the guard at the College library gate, first takes the player for Dobbo's thief, later lets him through.

first.speaker: Brunt
first.text: Stand where you are, stranger! Dobbo says you snatched a dagger off his counter and the bare hook on his wall proves it! Come along. I've got a cold and musty cell waiting just for you! Will you go quietly, stranger?

again.speaker: Brunt
again.text: We must drive out Grelvin! Smash his Undead and take back the Observatory.

later.speaker: Brunt
later.text: Hello Scholar! Come see me when you make Master.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Tolvar, the guard at the fort's main gate.

first.speaker: Tolvar
first.text: Aren't you supposed to be off fighting Trolls?

again.speaker: Tolvar
again.text: There is a smithy right behind Brannoc's hall.

later.speaker: Tolvar
later.text: I've been ordered not to leave the wall.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Tolvar, a guard at the town gate, while the Imps of the Cinder Caves raid Orvak.

first.speaker: Tolvar
first.text: The Imps are pouring out of the Cinder Caves! Mayor Dunbrak wants you at once!

again.speaker: Tolvar
again.text: I wonder who trims Mayor Dunbrak's beard?

later.speaker: Tolvar
later.text: I sense a dark storm gathering over Orvak! Will we ever be free of these Imps?

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Tobb at the north gate, shut while Chief Urgoth's Ogres hold Fort Ulm.

first.speaker: Tobb
first.text: Those Ogres never would have taken Fort Ulm if Oberik had been here!

again.speaker: Tobb
again.text: No, nobody goes north while the Ogres hold Fort Ulm!

later.speaker: Tobb
later.text: Did you see which way Urgoth ran? An Ogre that big couldn't just disappear!

variants.specifics: Corvale: Haldo keeps the North Gate, shut while the Ogres hold the north road.

first.speaker: Haldo
first.text: You're awful scrawny for an Ogre hunter. Haw, haw, haw...!
